limitations: Illustrative low/high WER and signed pair extremes, not a random or representative listening sample.
Two generation seeds are covered, but selections are not balanced by seed or text.
Actual multi-segment examples are present for all three split systems; strategy name alone does not mean an individual example was split.
Audio bytes and headers are verified; naturalness, timbre, prosody, semantic completeness and human preference were not judged.
Selected bundle omits the one output_limit case from A and the one from B184; not all failure modes are represented. B selects 2/5 output_limit cases, BNoLM 1/1, BSplit 1/1, B184NoLM 2/4.

overall.method: Percentile bootstrap: sample text clusters with replacement within length stratum; retain every paired seed in the sampled cluster; recompute micro WER.
overall.ci_note: Conditional on these text sources, observed seed pairs, and available scores; excludes uncertainty from training randomness and the ASR model.
